question.problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & b & 0 \\ 0 & c & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{3}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{3}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
question.worked_solution:
Each term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form corresponds to the entry ${a}_{ij}$ of the matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & ={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{3}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{3} \\  & =1{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+0{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{3} \\  & +\,0{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+(-2){x}_{2}{y}_{2}+0{x}_{2}{y}_{3} \\  & +\,0{x}_{3}{y}_{1}+1{x}_{3}{y}_{2}+1{x}_{3}{y}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, the corresponding matrix of the bilinear form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & \,\,-2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=1,$ $b=-2,$ and $c=1.$ Finally, 

$$
a+b+c=1+(-2)+1=0.
$$
